service_fee.name: Service fee
service_fee.desc: Flat amount charged once per checkout on store and shopper orders
service_fee.what: A small flat fee added to a customer's checkout when they order from stores or use a shopper.
service_fee.applies_to: Store orders and shopper orders. Not rides, courier trips or Blink Cash.
service_fee.example: A customer buys from 2 stores in one checkout and the fee is 1.50 DA. They pay 1.50 DA once, not 3 DA.
service_fee.caution: The service fee is charged once per checkout, even when the cart holds several stores.

courier_fare.name: Courier fare
courier_fare.desc: Delivery price per vehicle: base, included km, price per km, max km
courier_fare.what: The price of sending a parcel: a base price, some included kilometres, then a price for every extra km. Each vehicle class has its own prices.
courier_fare.who_pays: The customer who sends the parcel.
courier_fare.applies_to: Courier orders: a parcel picked up in one place and delivered to one or more places.
courier_fare.example: Moto: base 250 DA with 3 km included and 40 DA per km after. A 5 km parcel costs 250 + 2 × 40 = 330 DA, before any multiplier.
courier_fare.caution: Extra stops add the extra stop fee. A new vehicle class only shows correctly in the latest app.

ride_fare.name: Ride fare
ride_fare.desc: Ride price: base, included km, price per km, max km
ride_fare.what: The price of a passenger ride: a base price, some included kilometres, then a price for every extra km. Each vehicle class has its own prices.
ride_fare.example: Moto: base 200 DA with 3 km included and 40 DA per km after. A 6 km ride costs 200 + 3 × 40 = 320 DA, before any multiplier.
ride_fare.caution: Moto Comfort needs the latest app. Keep it switched off in Vehicles until the update is out.

fare_multiplier.name: Fare multiplier
fare_multiplier.desc: Manual surge or discount applied to courier and ride fares
fare_multiplier.what: One dial that makes every fare in its scope dearer or cheaper. ×1.00 changes nothing, ×1.20 adds 20%, ×0.90 takes 10% off.
fare_multiplier.who_earns: The rider and Blink, because the commission is a share of the fare.
fare_multiplier.applies_to: Courier fares, ride fares and marketplace delivery priced by distance.
fare_multiplier.example: A 5 km ride costs 320 DA. With ×1.20 it becomes 384 DA, then rounds to 390 DA.
fare_multiplier.caution: A big multiplier raises every fare in its scope at once. Check it in the Simulator, and use a dated custom price for a short rush or promotion.

rider_commission_rate.name: Rider commission
rider_commission_rate.desc: Share of the fare Blink keeps from each trip
rider_commission_rate.what: The share of each trip's fare that Blink keeps. The rider receives the rest.
rider_commission_rate.who_pays: The rider, out of their fare.
rider_commission_rate.applies_to: Trips of every service: store, shopper, courier and ride.
rider_commission_rate.example: At 15% on a 330 DA fare, Blink keeps 49.50 DA and the rider receives 280.50 DA.
rider_commission_rate.caution: The rate is saved on each order when it is created, so changing it never rewrites earnings or dues already recorded.

merchant_commission_rate.name: Merchant commission
merchant_commission_rate.desc: Share of delivered sales Blink keeps
merchant_commission_rate.what: The share of a merchant's delivered sales that Blink keeps.
merchant_commission_rate.who_pays: The merchant, out of their sales.
merchant_commission_rate.applies_to: Store orders once delivered. One merchant can have their own rate.
merchant_commission_rate.example: At 5%, 10 000 DA of delivered sales means 500 DA of commission.
merchant_commission_rate.caution: The rate is saved on each order when it is created, so changing it never changes past dues.

blink_cash_fee_rate.name: Blink Cash fee
blink_cash_fee_rate.desc: Fee the rider pays on deposits and withdrawals
blink_cash_fee_rate.what: The fee taken on each Blink Cash deposit or withdrawal.
blink_cash_fee_rate.who_pays: The rider who deposits or withdraws.
blink_cash_fee_rate.who_earns: Blink and the agent who handles it, split by the agent platform share.
blink_cash_fee_rate.example: At 2%, moving 5 000 DA costs a fee of 100 DA.

agent_platform_share.name: Agent platform share
agent_platform_share.desc: Share of each Blink Cash fee that goes to Blink
agent_platform_share.what: The part of each Blink Cash fee that goes to Blink. The agent keeps the rest.
agent_platform_share.who_pays: It comes out of the Blink Cash fee, not from the rider on top.
agent_platform_share.who_earns: Blink gets this share, the agent gets the rest.
agent_platform_share.applies_to: Blink Cash fees handled by agents. One agent can have their own share.
agent_platform_share.example: Of a 100 DA fee with a 20% share, Blink keeps 20 DA and the agent keeps 80 DA.

rider_cancel_penalty.name: Rider cancel penalty
rider_cancel_penalty.desc: Amount charged when a rider cancels an accepted job
rider_cancel_penalty.what: A fixed amount charged to a rider who cancels a job after accepting it.
rider_cancel_penalty.applies_to: Accepted jobs of every service: store, shopper, courier and ride.
rider_cancel_penalty.example: With a penalty of 200 DA, a rider who accepts a ride and then cancels pays 200 DA.

stamp_duty_rate.name: Stamp duty
stamp_duty_rate.what: A tax taken on merchant sales.
stamp_duty_rate.who_pays: The merchant, out of their sales.
stamp_duty_rate.who_earns: The tax authority. Blink collects and passes it on.
stamp_duty_rate.applies_to: Delivered store orders. It is one value for all of Algeria.
stamp_duty_rate.example: At 1%, 10 000 DA of sales means 100 DA of stamp duty.

agent_tax_rate.name: Agent withholding tax
agent_tax_rate.what: A tax withheld from the agent's own share of Blink Cash fees.
agent_tax_rate.who_pays: The agent, out of their share.
agent_tax_rate.who_earns: The tax authority. Blink withholds it and passes it on.
agent_tax_rate.applies_to: Blink Cash fees processed by agents. It is one value for all of Algeria.
agent_tax_rate.example: At 1%, on 80 DA of agent share, 0.80 DA is withheld.

dues_payment_fee_rate.name: Dues payment fee
dues_payment_fee_rate.desc: Fee on merchant and agent dues payments
dues_payment_fee_rate.what: A processing fee charged when a merchant or an agent pays the dues they owe to Blink.
dues_payment_fee_rate.who_pays: The merchant or agent who pays the dues.
dues_payment_fee_rate.applies_to: Dues payments by merchants and agents. It is one value for all of Algeria.
dues_payment_fee_rate.example: At 0.2%, paying 50 000 DA of dues costs a fee of 100 DA.

fare_formula.name: Fare formula
fare_formula.desc: Road factor, speeds, rounding, min and max fare, stop and boarding time
fare_formula.what: The fixed recipe that turns a distance into a price: road factor, speeds, rounding, minimum and maximum fare, and time at stops.
fare_formula.who_pays: The customer, through every courier, ride and distance-priced delivery fare.
fare_formula.applies_to: Courier, rides and marketplace delivery in distance mode.
fare_formula.example: A 4 km straight line times a road factor of 1.3 is 5.2 km of road. A fare of 331 DA rounds up to 340 DA with a step of 10 DA.
fare_formula.caution: Changing the formula changes many prices at once. Test it in the Simulator first.

dropoff_surcharge.name: Drop-off surcharge
dropoff_surcharge.desc: Extra charge priced at the drop-off place, optionally only when the tier changes
dropoff_surcharge.what: An extra fee added when the drop-off is in a different kind of place than the pickup, for example city to village.
dropoff_surcharge.who_earns: Shared between the rider and Blink, like the rest of the fare.
dropoff_surcharge.applies_to: Courier, rides and distance-priced delivery. It is looked up at the drop-off place (the last drop-off for courier).
dropoff_surcharge.example: Surcharge 100 DA, only when the tier changes: city to village adds 100 DA, village to another village adds nothing.

service_area.name: Service area
service_area.desc: Turn Blink on or off for a place; when off, quotes there are unavailable
service_area.what: Switches Blink on or off for a place. When off, nobody can order a ride or courier from there.
service_area.applies_to: Courier and ride requests whose pickup is in the scope.
service_area.example: Switch it off for the zone "Desert road": customers there see that Blink is not available and cannot order.
service_area.caution: Off blocks new orders right away. Only the latest app shows a clear "out of service area" message; older apps show a generic error.

zone_defaults.name: Unzoned tier
zone_defaults.desc: The tier for points outside every drawn zone
zone_defaults.what: The tier used for any point outside every drawn zone.
zone_defaults.applies_to: Every price that depends on the place: courier, rides and store delivery. It can be set for one wilaya.
zone_defaults.example: You only drew Tizi Ouzou city and the unzoned tier is Rural. A village outside the city is priced as Rural.
zone_defaults.caution: Changing it re-prices every place you have not drawn in its scope.

store_delivery.name: Marketplace delivery
store_delivery.desc: Delivery fee on store orders: the merchant's own fee, or priced by distance per vehicle class, with a min and max
store_delivery.what: How a store order's delivery fee is decided: the store's own fee (merchant mode) or a price from the distance between store and customer (distance mode).
store_delivery.who_pays: The customer, once per store in the order.
store_delivery.example: Distance mode with base 250 DA, 3 km included and 40 DA per km: a store 5 km away charges 330 DA. In merchant mode it charges its own fee, for example 200 DA.
store_delivery.caution: Distance mode needs the latest app. Keep every zone on merchant mode until customers have updated.

overrides.empty_none_body: A custom price replaces the default for one place, service, merchant or agent, and can stop on a date. Use it for a city, a promotion or a special deal.

formula.title: How a fare is computed
formula.desc: Six fixed steps, in this order. The values shown are today's defaults; click one to edit it.
formula.note: Zone and tier prices replace these defaults for trips priced there. Courier distance adds up pickup to every drop-off.

km.title: Road distance
km.desc: Straight-line km × road factor, rounded to 0.1 km.

raw.title: Raw price
raw.desc: Base + km beyond the included ones × price per km + minutes × price per minute + extra stops + drop-off surcharge.

scale.title: Multiplier
scale.desc: Raw price × fare multiplier (surge or discount).

clamp.title: Minimum and maximum
clamp.desc: Never below the minimum fare; never above the maximum when one is set.

round.title: Rounding
round.desc: Rounded to the rounding step, up, nearest or down.

intro.overview: Your control room. See every price Blink charges and every rate it keeps, and click a pencil to change one. Start with the guide if you are new.
intro.zones: Draw a <zone>zone</zone> around each city or town and give it a <tier>tier</tier>. Anything you do not draw is priced as the <unzoned>unzoned</unzoned> tier. Use this page to say where prices change.
intro.tiers: Compare each <tier>tier</tier> side by side and set a price for a whole tier at once, for example every village. Use this page to change prices for a kind of place.
intro.vehicles: Define the <vclass>vehicle classes</vclass> riders can have (Bicycle, Moto, Moto Comfort) and which services each one serves. Use this page to switch a class on or off.
intro.formula: See how a distance becomes a price, step by step, and test it on the map. Use this page to understand a fare or change the recipe behind all fares.
intro.overrides: A custom price (an <override>override</override>) replaces the default for one <scope>scope</scope>: a place, a service, a merchant or an agent. Use this page to add, extend or end special prices.
intro.simulator: Pretend to place an order and see exactly what the customer pays and who gets what. Use this page to check a price before or after you change it.
intro.history: A log of every pricing change: who changed what, when, and from which value to which. Use this page to answer "why did this price change?".

empty.zones_body: A zone is a shape on the map, such as a city or a town. Until you draw one, every place is priced as the unzoned tier. Use the polygon tool on the map: click around the city, close the shape, then name it and pick its tier.
empty.history_body: Every time someone changes a default, a custom price, a zone, a tier or a vehicle class, it is listed here with their name and the old and new value. Nothing has been changed yet.
empty.vehicles_body: Vehicle classes decide which riders can take which jobs and what each trip costs. Add Bicycle and Moto to start.

about.title: About this setting
about.varies_none: One value for everywhere. It cannot be changed for a single place or partner.
about.varies_dates: dates (a custom price can start and stop on a day)

fieldHelp.base: The starting price of a trip, in DA, before any distance is added. For example 250 DA.
fieldHelp.included_km: Kilometres covered by the base price, so no per-km charge yet. For example 3 km.
fieldHelp.per_km: Price per km after the included distance, in DA. For example 40 DA/km.
fieldHelp.per_minute: Optional price per minute of driving, in DA. 0 means time is free. For example 2 DA/min.
fieldHelp.max_km: Longest trip allowed, in km. Farther trips are shown as too far and cannot be ordered. For example 40 km.
fieldHelp.extra_stop_fee: Added for each drop-off after the first one on a courier order, in DA. For example 60 DA.
fieldHelp.amount: A fixed price in DA. For example 200 DA.
fieldHelp.rate: A percentage of the amount it applies to. For example 5% of 10 000 DA is 500 DA.
fieldHelp.multiplier: Multiplies the price. 1.00 changes nothing, 1.20 adds 20%, 0.90 takes 10% off.
fieldHelp.road_factor: Roads are longer than a straight line. Straight-line km are multiplied by this to get driven km. For example 1.3 turns 4 km into 5.2 km.
fieldHelp.rounding_step: Fares are rounded to a multiple of this amount, in DA. For example 10 DA makes 331 DA become 340 DA.
fieldHelp.rounding_mode: Which way a fare is rounded to the step.
fieldHelp.min_fare: A fare is never lower than this, in DA. 0 means no minimum. For example 150 DA.
fieldHelp.max_fare: A fare is never higher than this, in DA. 0 means no cap. For example 3 000 DA.
fieldHelp.min_ride_km: Rides shorter than this straight-line distance are refused as too close, in km. For example 0.3 km.
fieldHelp.speed_kmh: Average speed used to estimate driving time, in km/h. For example 28 km/h for a moto.
fieldHelp.stop_minutes: Minutes a courier spends at each stop, used for time estimates. For example 3 min.
fieldHelp.boarding_minutes: Minutes the passenger takes to get on, used for ride time estimates. For example 2 min.
fieldHelp.only_when_tier_changes: On: charged only when the drop-off tier differs from the pickup tier (city to village). Off: charged on every trip.
fieldHelp.enabled: On: customers can order here. Off: quotes say the place is out of the service area and orders are blocked.
fieldHelp.unzoned_tier: The tier used for any point outside every drawn zone. Usually the cheapest kind of place, such as Rural.
fieldHelp.mode: How the delivery fee is decided. See the two options below.
fieldHelp.min_fee: Delivery is never cheaper than this, in DA, in both modes. 0 means no minimum. For example 100 DA.
fieldHelp.max_fee: Delivery is never dearer than this, in DA, in both modes. 0 means no cap. For example 600 DA.

rounding_mode.up: Always rounds up. 331 DA becomes 340 DA. Never loses money.
rounding_mode.nearest: Rounds to the closest step. 331 DA becomes 330 DA, 336 DA becomes 340 DA.
rounding_mode.down: Always rounds down. 339 DA becomes 330 DA. Cheaper for the customer.

mode.merchant: Merchant: the customer pays the delivery fee that each store set itself. Nothing changes.
mode.distance: Distance: Blink prices delivery from the distance between the store and the customer, using the fare legs below. Needs the latest app.

tier.label: Tier
tier.def: A kind of place: city, town or village. Prices can be set for a whole tier at once.

zone.label: Zone
zone.def: A shape drawn on the map, such as a city. Each zone has one tier, and every point inside it is priced with that tier.

unzoned.label: Unzoned
unzoned.def: Any point outside every drawn zone. It is priced with the unzoned tier, usually Rural.

override.label: Custom price (override)
override.def: A price that replaces the default for one scope, and can start and end on a date. It is also called an override.

scope.label: Scope
scope.def: Where a custom price applies: a zone, a tier, a wilaya, a service, a merchant or an agent. No scope means everywhere.

multiplier.label: Multiplier
multiplier.def: A number that scales fares. ×1.00 changes nothing, ×1.20 makes fares 20% dearer.

surcharge.label: Surcharge
surcharge.def: An extra amount added on top of a fare in certain cases, for example when the drop-off is in another tier.

vehicle_class.label: Vehicle class
vehicle_class.def: A type of ride or delivery vehicle, such as Bicycle, Moto or Moto Comfort. Each class has its own fare.

exclusive.label: Exclusive class
exclusive.def: A class whose jobs are offered only to riders of that class. Other riders never see them.

includedkm.label: Included km
includedkm.def: Distance already paid for by the base price. The per-km price starts after it.

roadfactor.label: Road factor
roadfactor.def: How much longer real roads are than a straight line. 1.3 means 30% longer.

risk.title: Please check before you save
risk.intro: This change is worth a second look:

service_area_off.title: You are switching the service off
service_area_off.body: Customers will not be able to order rides or couriers from this place. Only the latest app shows a clear message; older apps show a generic error.

multiplier_high.title: A big price increase
multiplier_high.body: A multiplier above 1.5 makes every fare in this scope more than 50% dearer at once. Check it in the Simulator first.

multiplier_low.title: A big discount
multiplier_low.body: A multiplier below 0.8 takes more than 20% off every fare in this scope, so Blink and riders earn less on every trip.

distance_mode.title: Delivery will be priced by distance
distance_mode.body: Stores in this scope stop using their own delivery fee. This needs the latest app; older apps may not show the right price. Keep merchant mode where customers have not updated yet.

class_app_update.title: This class needs the app update
class_app_update.body: Moto Comfort only shows in the latest app. If you enable it before the update is out, customers on older versions cannot choose it.

all_algeria.title: This applies to all of Algeria with no end date
all_algeria.body: No place is chosen and no dates are set, so the new price is live everywhere right now and stays until someone changes it again.

guide.title: How pricing works
guide.subtitle: Two minutes to understand every price in Blink.

layers.title: 1. Prices come in layers
layers.intro: Every price starts from a default. A more specific custom price can replace it. The more specific it is, the more points it scores, and the highest score wins.
layers.default_desc: One price for all of Algeria.
layers.service_desc: Only courier, only rides, only store orders…
layers.wilaya_desc: One wilaya, for example Tizi Ouzou.
layers.tier_desc: A kind of place: Urban, Town, Rural.
layers.zone_desc: A shape you drew on the map. It already includes its wilaya and tier.
layers.partner_desc: A deal for one named partner.
layers.extras_title: Two things work across all layers
layers.extra_class: Vehicle class: Bicycle, Moto and Moto Comfort each have their own fare, and each one is matched to its own custom price separately.
layers.extra_dates: Dates: a custom price can start and end on a day. Outside those dates it is ignored and the next best price applies.

wins.title: 2. Which price wins?
wins.body: The most specific matching custom price wins. Points add up when one custom price matches on several things: Rural (4) in Tizi Ouzou (2) scores 6 and beats Rural alone (4). A zone already includes its wilaya and tier, so it cannot be combined with them. If nothing matches, the default applies. Places outside every zone use the unzoned tier.
wins.order: Order: merchant or agent (16) > zone (8) > tier (4) > wilaya (2) > service (1) > default

example.title: 3. A worked example
example.intro: A customer orders from the store sintta, in a village near Tizi Ouzou.
example.s1: The store is outside every drawn zone, so it takes the unzoned tier: Rural.
example.s2: Delivery has a Rural price, so the Rural tier price applies. It beats the Tizi Ouzou price (2 points) and the default.
example.s3: Unless sintta has its own custom price. A merchant deal scores 16 and beats the Rural price (4).
example.s4: If that deal has an end date, after it the Rural price applies again. Nobody has to remember to undo it.

formula.title: 4. How a fare is calculated
formula.intro: Courier and ride fares are built in six steps, always in this order:
formula.s1: Measure the road distance: straight-line km times the road factor.
formula.s2: Estimate the driving time from the distance and the vehicle speed.
formula.s3: Add the base price, the km beyond the included ones, any time charge, extra stops and the drop-off surcharge.
formula.s4: Multiply by the fare multiplier (a surge or a discount).
formula.s5: Keep the result between the minimum and the maximum fare.
formula.s6: Round to the rounding step (up, nearest or down).
